lessons.title: The first hour: stop, don’t chase
lessons.content:
# The first hour: stop, don’t chase

You noticed a missing balance. The next hour decides whether the rest leaves too. Speed toward a helper is how the rest leaves. Speed toward remaining funds, on a clean device, is how something survives.

By the end of this lesson you should run an order of operations from memory, recognise chase in all its costumes, and treat “I can outrun it by sending to their refund address” as a second gift.

## Order of operations

1. **Reject** any open popups. Close the suspicious tab. Do **not** smash the phone so hard you cannot use a **clean** device. Do not install an APK the group just dropped.
2. **Do not** message a group with “I got hacked, what do I do?” until you have moved what you still control. Impersonators are faster than friends. Pain in public is still bait, especially now.
3. From a **clean** device if possible, open bookmarked explorer. Name the door (previous lesson): device, account, chain permission, human-plus-send.
4. If Door 2 (exchange): bookmark login, kill sessions, change password, check whitelist and recent withdrawals, official ticket. Next lesson details this.
5. If Door 3: revoke from a bookmark if the seed still looks yours; move remaining funds to a fresh wallet if the device is dirty.
6. If Door 1: **new seed on a clean device**, test, move what is left, retire the old address forever. Next lesson. Never “repair” the old words on a recovery site.
7. Write hashes and timestamps in a private notebook. Only then tell a trusted human you already knew **offline**. Still no seed, no OTP, no screen share in that conversation.

If you cannot tell Door 1 from Door 3 in the first ten minutes, protect remaining funds as if Door 1 might be open: new wallet on a clean device, test, move. Extra caution is cheaper than a second drain. Revoke can wait until the rest is out of the fire.

Write one sentence in the notebook before you talk: “Door __ opened; remaining moved to __ (middles only); hashes __.” That sentence is for you and for a real desk later. It is not a status for Telegram. Status is how impersonators find you while the rest is still on the dirty phone.

## What chase looks like

- paying a recovery wizard, including with leftover dust
- sending more to “unlock,” “unstick,” or “refund”
- installing an APK the group dropped
- repeating the same dApp to “reverse”
- sharing a screen so a competent voice can drive
- googling the error and tapping ads
- posting a bounty with your remaining address

TABLE
Impulse | First-hour replacement
Tell Telegram immediately | Move remaining first, then a quiet offline human
Pay unfreeze / tracer / dust fee | No
New APK / remote desktop | No
Second send to thief “refund” | No — you cannot outrun a valid signature
Re-enter seed to repair | No — new words, never repaired old ones
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** 40 USDT gone via approve. 12 USDT and some BNB remain. The student still has the seed on a possibly dirty phone.

1. They reject leftover popups. They do not post in the fan group.
2. From a friend’s clean laptop they create a **new** wallet, official app, paper words, no photo.
3. They send a test of 1 USDT from the old wallet (imported once, onto the clean laptop if they must, not onto a new APK). Bookmarked explorer agrees.
4. Then the rest of the 11, then BNB dust minus gas. Then they may revoke on the old address. Then they tell a friend. Still no seed in the story.
5. The 12 USDT survives. The 40 does not come back. That is still a successful first hour.

DIAGRAM
Notice loss
   --> reject popups
   --> clean device if the old one may be dirty
   --> name the door on bookmarked explorer
   --> save remaining (test, then the rest)
   --> notes
   --> then talk, still no seed

X recovery payments
X refund address of the thief
X group announcement first
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Saving remaining funds is not “giving up on the stolen slice.” The stolen slice is already a different address’s money. The chain will not parent you into a reversal. Chasing it is how the remaining slice follows. Dust left behind is allowed. Dust sent to a specialist is a donation.
ENDNOTE

If the dirty phone is also your only 2FA, you have two doors in one pocket. Do not factory-reset it until you have killed exchange sessions from a cleaner device and rotated what you can. A reset that you cannot log in after is how people then accept a skip-the-queue admin. Sequence: remaining on-chain funds if Door 1 might be open; Door 2 sessions from a bookmark on a clean device; then you may retire the dirty phone.

## What this lesson is for

So that the worst hour of this course has a script. Scripts beat adrenaline. You do not need to feel brave. You need to move the rest, then write, then talk. Bravery that announces the loss first is how remaining funds get a spectator sport. Quiet is a security control.

## Say this out loud

- Remaining funds first, story later. Clean device if the old one may be dirty.
- I cannot outrun a drain by sending to the thief’s refund address.
- No recovery payments, no dust-as-tracing-fee, no APK, no screen share.
- If I cannot name the door yet, I still move remaining funds as if Door 1 might be open.
- Naming the door picks the next fix. A group chat picks a second predator.

Quiet is a control. Announce after remaining funds have moved. The group that would have “helped” was already watching for the announcement.

Next: rotating a leaked seed — new wallet, never “repair” the old words, thieves watching empty addresses.

lessons.title: Rotating a leaked seed (new wallet, never “repair” the old words)
lessons.content:
# Rotating a leaked seed (new wallet, never “repair” the old words)

If the words may have been photographed, typed into a site, stored in cloud notes, spoken on a screen share, or entered on a fake app: **that wallet is no longer yours alone.** Shared ownership is the fact. Hope is not a detector.

By the end of this lesson you should run rotation as a procedure, refuse repair-sites, and treat an empty leaked address as a camera the thief still watches.

## When to rotate

Rotate if: you typed the seed into a website; you imported into a chat APK; you stored it in Google Notes, a screenshot album, or email; a helper saw it; overlay malware may have seen it; you used the words on a dirty OS. “Nothing happened yet” is not a sensor. Thieves wait for deposits.

Do not rotate in a panic onto the same infected phone. Clean device first — a friend’s laptop is imperfect and still better than the APK that stole the last seed. Official store listing you already used. Paper backup. No photo. A screenshot of a seed in the gallery is not encrypted in any sense this academy will accept. It is a picture of the vault, often backed up to a cloud.

## Procedure

1. On a **clean** device, official wallet app (Trust Wallet, MetaMask, or others remain **examples**, not orders), generate a **new** seed. Write on paper. Never photo. Never type it into chat “so a helper can check spelling.”
2. Note the new receive address on BNB Smart Chain. Check middles.
3. From the old wallet (clean device if you can import **once**), send a **test** of play USDT to the new address. Bookmarked explorer agrees. Middles match.
4. Move remaining tokens you understand, then remaining BNB (leave a drop for the last gas if you still need one revoke or one last send).
5. If NFTs or odd tokens, decide later — do not visit claim sites to “bring them along.” That is how Door 3 rides the rotation.
6. Never reuse the old seed. Do not “keep it as a burner.” Burners with leaked seeds are still shared with the thief.
7. Update an exchange withdrawal whitelist to the **new** address after a delay you can live with, from the bookmarked exchange.
8. If you used that seed on other chains, those balances need the same move, with each chain’s native gas. One seed is many doors.

## What you do not do

- email the new seed to yourself
- generate the new seed on the same infected phone
- ask a helper to “create the new wallet for you”
- paste old words into a “wallet repair,” “migration,” or “BSC resync” site
- send leftover dust to a specialist so they can “close the case”
- announce the new address in the same group that saw the old one drain

TABLE
Old wallet | New wallet
Compromised, watched, retired | Clean device, paper backup, almost no random connects
Whitelist later, after a test you control | After explorer agrees you hold it
Burner reuse of leaked words | No — it is still their camera
Repair the old twelve words | No — there is no honest repair
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A seed sat in Google Notes for a year. Nothing happened. A student still rotates, because absence of a drain is not proof of absence of a copy.

1. New words on a clean device, paper, no photo. Notes copy deleted — and they still assume cloud copies can persist. The rotation is the fix, not the delete.
2. Test 1 USDT, explorer agrees, then the rest, then BNB.
3. They do not sweep a mystery airdrop along. They hide it on the old address and walk away.
4. Empty old address stays empty. If 0.0003 BNB remains as dust, it remains. A tracer who wants it is Module 3.

DIAGRAM
Leaked seed
   --> new seed on clean device (paper, no photo)
   --> test send
   --> move tokens you understand
   --> move gas, leave dust if needed
   --> retire old address forever
   --> whitelist the new one later, from a bookmark

X repair site for old words
X same dirty phone
X helper generates it
X burner reuse
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you have nothing left to move, still generate a new wallet for the future. Do not “keep using” the leaked one because it is empty today. Thieves watch old addresses. A future salary sent there is a future gift. There is no parent who will intercept it because you already learned the lesson.
ENDNOTE

Other chains on the same seed are the same leak. Ethereum, Polygon, whatever else that seed derived — each needs its own gas and its own move. Forgetting a chain is how a later airdrop on that chain becomes the thief’s airdrop. Write a list of networks you ever added, then move or abandon on purpose.

## What this lesson is for

So that leaked words stop being a superstition (“maybe they didn’t copy it”) and become a procedure. New, clean, paper, test, move, retire. Repair is a costume. If a helper offers to “check the new words are valid,” they are asking for the new vault. Validity is a receive test you already ran on the explorer.

## Say this out loud

- A leaked seed means shared ownership. “Nothing happened yet” is not a detector.
- New seed, clean device, paper, no photo, test, move, retire. I never repair the old words.
- Empty leaked wallets are still cameras. I will not reuse them as burners.
- Helpers do not generate my new seed. Repair sites that want the old words are thieves.
- A screenshot in the gallery is a leak, not an encrypted backup.

Other chains on the same seed are the same leak. Move them or abandon them on purpose. An empty leaked address is still a camera.

Next: exchange session theft and 2FA loss — Door 2, where a parent still exists if you use the parent, not a Telegram skip-the-queue.

lessons.title: Exchange session theft and 2FA loss
lessons.content:
# Exchange session theft and 2FA loss

Door 2 has a parent. Use the parent, not a DM. An exchange IOU is still a company ledger. That is a cost (they can freeze you) and a feature (they can kill sessions). Binance and any other desk you actually use remain **examples of centralised exchanges**, not a ranking.

By the end of this lesson you should kill sessions from a bookmark, treat lost 2FA as official recovery plus paper codes, and assume SMS 2FA is dead during a SIM-swap.

## You still have login

From a bookmark, not from an email button:

- kill sessions / devices you do not recognise
- rotate password to something unique (password reuse is how one shopping leak becomes this hour)
- rotate 2FA: new authenticator secret, new paper backup codes; destroy the old codes
- confirm withdrawal whitelist is on; inspect recent address additions
- confirm recent withdrawals; official ticket if you see one you did not start
- check the email account that owns the exchange — Door 2 often starts there

Do this even if the thief only “tried.” Tried is a session you might still be sharing.

## You lost the 2FA device

Official account recovery. Slow. Identity checks. This is why 2FA backup codes on paper exist. Anyone offering to skip the queue in Telegram is stealing the account. Anyone who needs a seed to restore an exchange login is confused or lying: exchange logins are not seeds. Do not “help” them by pasting wallet words into an exchange-shaped clone.

If you still have backup codes, you are not lost. If you do not, you are in the company’s slow lane. Slow is infuriating and still better than a skip-the-queue admin.

## SIM-swap in progress

Someone is moving your mobile number. SMS 2FA is now their 2FA. Call the mobile operator on a number **you already had** — the shop, the printed bill, the number on paper — not a number a text just sent. Ask to lock the SIM. Then rotate exchange and email passwords from a bookmark. Assume every SMS code is hostile until the operator confirms the line is yours.

Then leave SMS 2FA if the product allows an authenticator app. SMS was always the weak second factor. Today you have the demonstration. Academy login is a smaller Door 2, but it still gets a unique password. A phished academy session does not spend BNB. It can still be a costume: “we see you logged in, now verify the wallet.” That verify is not us.

TABLE
Situation | Channel | Not the channel
Session theft, you still log in | Bookmarked security page: sessions, password, 2FA, whitelist | Email button; reply-guy
Lost authenticator | Official recovery + paper backup codes | Telegram skip-the-queue
SMS / SIM-swap | Operator on a number you already had, then rotate off SMS | Number in the SMS itself
Stranger “exchange security team” | No | Ever
Academy password same as exchange | Rotate both to unique | “It’s fine, academy has no coins”
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A student’s email was a reused password from a leaked shop. The exchange used that email and SMS 2FA. SIM-swap Friday. They notice Saturday.

1. They still have a session on the exchange app from last week. They open *that* bookmarked app, not a text link.
2. Whitelist saved them: 24-hour delay on a new withdrawal address. They cancel what they can, kill sessions, rotate password, move 2FA to an authenticator, paper codes, call the operator on a known number.
3. Without whitelist, this page would be a eulogy for the IOU. The delay that felt insulting was the parent doing one job.
4. They also rotate the academy password, which had been the same. Progress is not BNB, and reuse still couples doors.

DIAGRAM
Door 2
  --> official security page from a bookmark
  --> sessions, password, 2FA, whitelist
  --> email account that owns it
  --> operator, if SIM is in play

  X Telegram skip-the-queue
  X seed paste into an exchange clone
  X SMS link
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Academy login is Door 2 for **this site** (progress, not your BNB). Still: do not reuse the exchange password on the academy. Password reuse is how one leak becomes three doors. Staff will never ask for your 2FA to “verify a ticket.”
ENDNOTE

If you cannot get in at all — no session, no 2FA device, no backup codes — you are in the company’s slow lane with identity documents. Slow is the honest cost of Door 2. Anyone who can “fast-track” you in a chat already has a login page. Use the parent’s published recovery. Eat the delay. The IOU is still an IOU until they finish; a clone login would make it theirs.

## What this lesson is for

So that Door 2 uses its parent. Parents are slow and annoying and occasionally on your side. Telegram is fast and never your exchange. Write the official recovery URL into your calm-day bookmarks the same way you bookmarked login. Fire-day you will not invent a desk. You will tap a desk you already had.

## Say this out loud

- Door 2: official parent from a bookmark, not DMs, not email buttons.
- Whitelist is the delay that saves IOUs. I will live with it.
- Paper 2FA backup codes exist for lost phones. Skip-the-queue admins exist for stolen accounts.
- SIM-swap: call an operator number I already had, then rotate off SMS 2FA.
- Password reuse couples doors. Academy and exchange do not share a password.

Bookmark the official recovery URL on a calm day, next to login. Fire-day you will not invent a desk. Slow is the parent. Skip-the-queue is the thief.

Next: reporting versus revenge — hashes in a real process, not mixers, not bounties, not a second crime.

lessons.title: Reporting versus revenge
lessons.content:
# Reporting versus revenge

You may file a report. You may warn your group. You will not become a night-time detective sending bait funds into mixers “to catch them.” That is how people get a second loss and, in some places, a legal problem this academy will not help you shop for.

By the end of this lesson you should know what is useful (hashes, domains, official tickets), what is not (tracers, memos of threats, bounties in DMs), and that police recovery is not a promise we will make.

## What a local report is, without Hollywood

A report is a statement at a real office, or a platform form the company publishes, with facts a stranger could check: timestamps, transaction hashes, destination addresses, the domain you typed, the handle that DMed you. It is not a seed. It is not remote control of your phone. It is not a USDT retainer to a man with a badge photo.

Whether it is worth a trip depends on amount, city, and how that desk actually treats crypto complaints. In some places a statement creates a paper trail that matters for a bank, an employer, or a later case. In some places it is a queue that never moves. Both outcomes are allowed. This academy will not pretend a learner (or any other) police desk can unsend a BEP-20 transfer because you are a student. We will also not mock you for filing if the number would have paid school fees.

If you file, bring the notebook, not the remaining wallet on a hot screen in a public corridor. Remaining funds first, always. A report is not a reason to delay rotation.

## Useful

- BscScan hashes, timestamps, destination addresses, in a real-world police or platform report if the amount and local process justify it
- Warning friends with **facts** (“this domain drained me,” “this handle doubled CST”), not with a clone of the clone, not with your remaining address
- Telling the exchange, from a bookmark, if Door 2
- Telling a bank if P2P local currency sat in a story they can actually act on — they still may not; you still do not chase on-chain
- Writing the contract you verified, if a clone used a name collision with Crystal Stones: the real verify-only address is `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`

## Not useful, and not allowed as “homework”

- paying a mixer or a “tracer” in chat
- sending leftover dust to attach a trace
- threatening the destination address in a transaction memo
- deploying your own drainer (crime)
- doxxing random holders who later bought the stolen USDT on a DEX (they may be innocent liquidity)
- a public bounty that invites impersonators to play police

Warning well is a skill. Name the domain, the handle, the contract. Do not name your remaining address. Do not paste a screenshot that includes a receive QR. Do not offer to “help others recover” unless you are repeating this course’s refuse-lines — otherwise you become a costume someone else can wear.

Doxxing a random holder who bought USDT on a DEX after your drain is how innocent liquidity gets hurt and how you pick a fight that is not the thief. The book shows a path. Paths through public pools are not a confession of the pool.

## This academy is not a law firm. Local rules differ. We only insist you do not add a crime or a second drain to the story. We do not promise that a report brings funds home. Sometimes it creates a paper trail that matters later. Sometimes it does nothing. Both outcomes are allowed. Revenge ops are not.

TABLE
Act | Do?
Official report with hashes, if it makes sense locally | Optional, adult, no promises
Warn with the domain, handle, and drainer contract | Yes, without your remaining address
Pay Telegram police / mixer / dust tracer | No
Commit a crime to “get even” | No
Open a bounty in DMs | No — impersonators hunt bounties
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A student posts the **drainer contract** and domain in a community they already trust, plus a BscScan link. They do not post their remaining address. They do not offer a bounty in DMs. They file a local report because the number is large enough in their city that a desk will take a statement. They still plan as if the 40 USDT will not return.

1. Calm, factual, done.
2. A helper replies with “I am cybercrime, send dust.” They already had this module. They ignore.
3. They do not follow the stolen USDT into a mixer “to see.” Curiosity is not a tracing licence.
4. Sunday, remaining funds sit in a new play pocket. The report sits in a folder. Life continues without a Hollywood reverse.

DIAGRAM
Loss
  --> save remaining
  --> optional official report with hashes
  --> factual warning (domain, contract, handle)

  X revenge ops
  X mixers as detective work
  X bounties in open DMs
  X dust to specialists
  X threatening memos
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
We will not pretend every stolen 20 USDT deserves a task force, and we will not mock someone who files anyway. The skill is matching energy to reality: remaining funds, then paper, then quiet warnings. Not a second career as a bounty hunter the same night you were drained.
ENDNOTE

## What this lesson is for

So that anger has a channel that does not open a door. Reports are adult. Revenge is how Door 4 gets a sequel.

## Say this out loud

- Hashes help reports. Seeds never do. Dust never does.
- I warn with facts — domain, handle, contract — not with my remaining address.
- No mixer-detectives, no bounties in DMs, no crime to get even.
- Police recovery is not promised. I still may file if it makes sense locally.
- Impersonators hunt both pain posts and bounty posts. I do not feed them.

Next: what will not come back, said without cruelty — so hope does not become a third predator.

lessons.title: What will not come back, said without cruelty
lessons.content:
# What will not come back, said without cruelty

The chain settled a theft as calmly as a gift. That sentence is the spine of this course. This lesson says the quiet part without dressing it as a motivational poster and without dressing it as contempt.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to tell a friend, or yourself, which slices of a loss are gone, which habits still pay, and why leftover hope is a market that recovery specialists sell into.

## What is gone

A completed on-chain send to an address you do not control. A `transferFrom` that already happened. An exchange withdrawal that already left the company to a chain address. Painted-platform balances that were never in a wallet you held. Giveaway donations. Dust you sent to a tracer.

Gone means: do not budget as if a parent will reverse it. Do not skip rent to “stay in the recovery process.” Do not recruit a cousin to complete the task mill so the large withdrawal can free both of you. The large withdrawal is not in a queue. It is in someone else’s pocket.

## What may still be yours

Funds that never left. IOUs still inside an exchange if Door 2 was caught in the whitelist delay. Tokens still sitting behind an approval you can revoke before they fire. Other chains on a seed you are about to retire, if you move them first. Your KYC-facing name, if you refuse mule work now. Your audience, if you do not hand admin to a helper.

“May still be yours” is the first hour’s job. It is not a promise about the gone slice.

Grief is allowed. A number that would have paid fees is allowed to hurt. What is not allowed, in this classroom, is converting that hurt into a payment to a stranger who speaks the hurt’s language. Specialists listen well because listening is cheaper than returning USDT.

If you are sitting with someone else who lost money, do not rank their pain. Do not say “it was only practice size” unless they say it. Do not say “we will get it back.” Say: remaining funds, bookmarks, no seed, no dust, optional report, I will stay while you do the first hour.

## What will not happen, named so nobody sells it to you

- BSC validators will not vote you a refund because you are a student of this academy
- Crystal Stones staff will not DM a recovery agent
- A screenshot of a chat will not freeze a destination
- A second send will not unlock the first
- A mixer will not “clean and return”
- A court, even a real one, is not a vending machine for USDT. It may be worth a statement. It is not a timer you can count on before Friday’s bills

TABLE
Gone | Still a job | Not a job
Completed send / pull / CEX withdrawal that already hit-chain | Remaining funds, rotation, sessions, revoke | Tracer payments
Painted-site number | Stop depositing | Unfreeze tax
Giveaway donation | Warn with facts | Double down for VIP
Shame | Offline human you already knew | Screen share with a new friend
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** An auntie lost the number she cannot stand to say out loud. A niece sits with her. They do not say “at least it was a lesson” in the first ten minutes. They also do not say “we will get it back, I found a desk.”

1. They move what is left. They rotate if words were shared. They ignore recovery DMs together.
2. They write hashes. They decide, locally, whether a statement is worth a trip. No promise.
3. They tell two family chats the domain and the script. They do not tell them the remaining address.
4. Weeks later the money is still gone. The auntie still has a play pocket with practice size, a bookmark list, and a niece who will not let a wizard in the door. That is the un-cruel ending this academy can stand behind.

DIAGRAM
Stolen slice  -->  treat as gone
Remaining    -->  first hour, then rotation / sessions / revoke
Hope product -->  specialists, unfreeze taxes, last trains
                treat as Door 4

Sit with the person.
Do not sell them a reverse.
Do not mock them for wanting one.
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you are the person who lost the money, you are not “bad at crypto.” You met a funnel that is good at humans. Basic’s job was to make the next funnel more expensive to run on you. It was not to guarantee that the last one returns. Education only. No recovery theatre from us, ever.
ENDNOTE

## What this lesson is for

So that hope stops being a door. You can grieve a number. You can file a paper. You cannot buy a reverse from a stranger without buying a second loss. The immune system is the rest of your life on these rails, not a refund. If a cousin asks “but what if this specialist is different?”, the answer is still the never-list: no seed, no dust, no screen share, no second send. Different costumes. Same doors.

## Say this out loud

- A completed on-chain theft will not be parented back by validators, staff, or a second send.
- Remaining funds are the job. The gone slice is not a subscription I must feed.
- I will not skip rent for a recovery process. I will not send dust to close a case.
- Police reports are optional and local. They are not promised reversals.
- Shame is not a character flaw I must pay to remove. It is a feeling. Wizards sell to it.

If a cousin asks whether a specialist is different this time, the never-list is still the answer. Different badge. Same doors. No seed, no dust, no screen, no second send.

Take the quiz. Module 6: living the rules — weekly checklist, device hygiene, how to treat Crystal Stones after this course, Basic track close, and what Intermediate will still refuse.

lessons.title: A weekly safety checklist
lessons.content:
# A weekly safety checklist

Safety is a habit, not a mood after a scare. Moods fade. Sunday does not have to.

By the end of this lesson you should have a ten-minute list you can actually run, a per-popup list, and a per-DM list — and you should know that a week you skip is not a moral failure, it is a week the guns stay loaded.

## Every week (about ten minutes)

1. Open bookmarked exchange security: sessions look like you? Kill strangers.
2. Withdrawal whitelist still on? New addresses you did not add?
3. Bookmarked explorer approval checker: any new spenders you do not recognise? Revoke the unknowns. Finite-or-zero on DEX routers you are not using this month.
4. Phone and laptop: OS update pending? Random apps to delete? Overlay-junk, “boosters,” mystery APKs.
5. Seed paper still where you think it is — without photographing it, without unfolding it on a webcam, without typing it to “check.”
6. Practice pocket versus savings pocket still separate? Did a savings seed visit a sponsored link?
7. Any new official site you actually used? Add the bookmark **now**, not on a panic day.
8. Email inbox: a reset you did not ask for is a prompt to lock from a bookmark, not a button to tap.

If a week is too often at first, pick **Sunday and anytime you used a new dApp**. After a new dApp, check approvals the same day, not “later.” Later is how March becomes August.

Map the list to doors so it is not a blob: items 1–2 and 8 are Door 2 (account). Item 3 is Door 3 (chain permission). Items 4–6 are Door 1 (device and the keys that live there). Item 7 is Door 4 prevention (you will not search under stress). If you only have three minutes, do 1 and 3. If you only have one minute after a new dApp, do 3. Perfection is how people skip the week. A short pass still unloads a gun.

Keep a little BNB on the play pocket so revoke is possible. A loaded gun and a zero-gas wallet is how people accept “we will pay gas if you share the seed.” That sentence is still a no. Get practice-size BNB through a path you already trust, on a calm day, then revoke.

## Every time you sign

- Network chip (BNB Smart Chain is chain id **56** if that is the book you meant)
- Asset (USDT is not BNB is not Crystal Stones)
- Destination middle characters
- Is this connect, sign, approve, permit, or send?
- If confuse → reject. Tired → close.

Hardware: the device screen is the authority. Phone UI can lie. Blind confirm is still a yes.

## Every time a human messages about money, listing, support, or Mentor

- Did I start this from a bookmark?
- Are they asking for a door — seed, OTP, approve, remote control, “verify by sending USDT”?
- Academy never-ask-seed. Wallet support that needs the words is not support.
- Pain they are rushing is a prop.

TABLE
Cadence | Items | Failure mode if skipped
Weekly | Sessions, whitelist, approvals, junk apps, paper exists, bookmarks | Loaded guns and surprise logins
Per popup | Network, asset, destination middles, popup type | One tired yes
Per DM | Bookmark origin, door test, never-list | Door 4 opens 1–3
After a new dApp | Approvals the same day | March’s unlimited, August’s pull
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** Sunday, ten minutes. A student finds an unlimited USDT approve from a DEX they no longer use. Revoke, thirty seconds of gas. In December that spender is in the news. The Sunday habit was the whole defence. They did not need a whitepaper in December. They needed March’s hygiene.

A second student skips six Sundays, then does a two-hour “security day” in a panic after a cousin is drained. Panic days are for remaining funds, not for discovering bookmarked checkers. They still do the list. They also admit the list is easier when it is boring.

DIAGRAM
Weekly hygiene        --> fewer loaded guns, fewer surprise sessions
Per-popup read        --> fewer bad signatures
Per-DM door test      --> fewer social openings
After new dApp        --> same-day revoke of surprises

Skip the week         --> the guns stay loaded
Do not "make up" on a panic day by googling ads
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you only remember one weekly item, make it approvals plus sessions. Paper backup “exists” is the second. Everything else supports those two. This academy will not demand a screenshot of your checklist. We would not know what to do with it, and we would never ask for the words that sit under item 5.
ENDNOTE

Three minutes is still a week: kill strange sessions, open the bookmarked approval checker, revoke one surprise. Ten minutes is better. Two hours of panic-Googling is worse. Put the list where you will see it on Sunday — a paper note, not a screenshot of a seed. If you miss a Sunday, run it when you notice. Guilt is not a control. The list is.

## What this lesson is for

So that Safety does not end at the quiz. A list you can run tired is worth more than a personality called careful. Put it on a calendar if that is how your kitchen works. Skip-guilt is not a door. An unloaded gun on Monday is.

## Say this out loud

- Weekly: sessions, whitelist, approvals, junk apps, confirming paper backup exists, adding bookmarks on calm days.
- Per popup: network, asset, middles, type — or reject.
- Per DM: did I start this from a bookmark, and are they asking for a door?
- After a new dApp, I check approvals the same day.
- Habits beat slogans. I will not google hygiene into ads on a fire day.

Three minutes still counts: sessions and one surprise spender. Guilt about a missed Sunday is not a control. An unloaded gun on Monday is.

Next: device hygiene that actually happens — updates, SIM-swap, a separate browser profile, and the junk you will actually delete.

lessons.title: Device hygiene that actually happens (updates, SIM-swap, separate browser profile)
lessons.content:
# Device hygiene that actually happens (updates, SIM-swap, separate browser profile)

A threat model that needs a cleanroom you will never build is a threat model you will ignore. This lesson is the subset that happens in real kitchens: updates, SIM-swap readiness, a separate browser profile for money, and deleting junk you already know is junk.

By the end of this lesson you should name three device habits you will actually keep, and refuse to generate a savings seed on a playground phone.

## Updates, without a sermon

OS updates close overlay holes and cloned-app holes you will never see in a changelog you enjoy reading. Turn them on. Wallet apps update from the **store listing you bookmarked**, not from a WhatsApp APK. Browser updates similarly. “I’ll update after this airdrop” is how the airdrop writes to memory you did not mean to share.

You do not need to become a sysadmin. You need to stop postponing the green button because a timer on a site said not to reboot.

## SIM-swap, as a boring drill

Write the mobile operator’s real shop number on the same paper-adjacent place you keep other adult numbers — not in a notes app titled “crypto.” If the line dies strangely, if OTPs stop, if a text says “your SIM is moving,” you call *that* number. You ask to lock the SIM. You then rotate exchange and email from bookmarks. You assume SMS 2FA is burned.

If the product offers an authenticator app, use it. Paper backup codes in the same house as the seed paper, not in the same photo album. Seeds and 2FA codes are different objects. They can share a drawer. They cannot share a screenshot.

## Separate browser profile (and why a second phone is optional)

A **browser profile** is a separate hat inside Chrome, Brave, Firefox, or similar: its own cookies, its own extensions. Money profile: almost no extensions, no “Web3 helper” you met in an ad, bookmarks for academy, explorer, exchange. Everyday profile: the rest of the internet, the rest of the cookies, the rest of the junk.

This is cheaper than a second phone and actually happens. A second phone or a hardware wallet is for amounts that would hurt, still with a test send, still reading the device screen. It is not required to finish Basic. It is architecture you can grow into.

Do not install random extensions that “simulate contracts” or “speed up BSC.” Extensions sit in the browser with the same view as you. They are Door 1-adjacent.

TABLE
Habit | Why it happens in a kitchen | What it is not
OS + store updates on | One green button | A reason to sideload an APK
Operator number on paper | One line of writing | A Telegram “telco desk”
Authenticator, not SMS only | One setup, paper codes | A seed paste into the exchange
Separate browser profile for money | Ten minutes, once | A cleanroom lab
Delete battery boosters and “WhatsApp plus” | You already know they are junk | An antivirus APK from a group
Savings seed not born on a playground phone | Wait for a cleaner device | Using the leaked one as a burner
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** Emeka’s Android has four “cleaner” APKs, SMS 2FA on the exchange, and MetaMask (an **example of a wallet app**) in the same Chrome profile he uses for football streams and random extensions.

1. He deletes the cleaners. He updates the OS. He creates a money profile with no extra extensions. He bookmarks academy, BscScan, the exchange.
2. He moves 2FA to an authenticator, paper codes in a drawer. He writes the operator number on the same card as his sister’s clinic.
3. Play pocket stays on the phone for now, practice size. Savings, when he has any, will wait for a cleaner setup. He does not generate a second seed on the old playground “just to have it.”
4. A week later a stream site wants a wallet extension. That ask stays in the everyday profile, which has no wallet. The money profile never visited the stream.

DIAGRAM
Everyday device / profile
  sports, chat, curiosity
  no savings seed
  no extra "Web3" extensions on the money hat

Money profile / quieter device
  bookmarks: academy, explorer, exchange, wallet store listing
  few or no extensions
  authenticator, not SMS only

SIM
  operator number on paper
  lock the line, then rotate Door 2
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Hardware still does not bless a playground. If the laptop that proposes transactions is a junkyard, read the device screen as if the laptop is hostile — because it might be. If you will not read the screen, the steel box is a very expensive yes.
ENDNOTE

A shared family phone is a shared Door 1. Children tap. Cousins install. If the savings seed lives there, it lives in a house with extra hands. Either the play pocket stays tiny, or the savings seed lives on a device those hands do not use. That sentence has ended more “I don’t know who signed it” stories than any antivirus.

## What this lesson is for

So that hygiene is a few things you will do, not a lifestyle you will perform on Twitter. Playgrounds do not birth savings seeds. Money gets a quieter hat.

## Say this out loud

- Updates come from the OS and the bookmarked store listing, not from a chat APK.
- I have the operator’s real number on paper. SIM-swap: lock the line, then rotate Door 2. SMS is a weak second factor.
- A separate browser profile for money is hygiene I can actually finish in ten minutes.
- I will not generate a savings seed on a playground of random APKs and extensions.
- Hardware still requires me to read the device screen. Blind signing is not hygiene.

# How to treat Crystal Stones and any other token after this course (verify contract, no hunt for clones)

Crystal Stones is a **BEP-20** token on **BNB Smart Chain**. That is a technical sentence, not a buy order. This academy will not tell you to buy it, hold it, or hunt a clone of it. The immune system you just built is how you look at *any* ticker without becoming the ticker’s prey.

By the end of this lesson you should verify a contract on a bookmarked explorer, refuse name-collision tokens, and treat academy surfaces (Mentor, checkout, certificates) as bookmarked product — not as dApps that need a gun.

## The only number this course wants you to memorise as a verify step

`0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`

Chain id **56**. Explorer: bookmarked BscScan. Native gas: **BNB**. Tokens do not pay their own fees.

Verify means: the contract you add, if you add one, matches that string in the middle characters, not only the first four. Verify does not mean: buy. Verify does not mean: the RWA or mineral-vault story is proven. That story is **their claim to verify** in later, slower work — not a slogan we will stamp for them, and not a reason to skip Safety.

A second contract with a similar name is a clone until your bookmark says otherwise. “Academy is late, use this one” is Module 3. “Last train” is Module 3. “Airdrop of 8 million CST” is Module 4. You already have the refusals.

## How academy surfaces fit

- **LMS / Mentor:** inside the bookmarked app. No seed. No permit. No remote control.
- **Certificates:** platform records after quizzes. Not a mint, not a connect-wallet event in Basic.
- **Paid tracks, later:** published checkout, USDT on BEP-20 via official the checkout processor when live. Not CST. Not PaynovaX. Not a WhatsApp QR. Not a personal 0x.
- **Staff:** will leave WhatsApp for the site. Will never DM a recovery agent.

Fake Crystal Stones sites, fake mentors, fake invoices, fake BscScan, fake Trust Wallet APKs — you have named all of them. The token does not get a special exception because you like the crystal. Like is Door 4’s favourite weather.

## Any other token, same rails

Wrong network still vanishes value. Unlimited approve still loads a gun. Unsolicited inbound is still junk. A DEX you did not bookmark is still a site. Hardware still needs a read. Practice size still applies when curiosity itches.

You will meet thousands of names. Being “on a blockchain” is not a quality stamp. Intermediate, if you continue, will add tools for reading contracts and tokenomics. It will not add a licence to skip the four doors.

TABLE
Action | Adult version | Costume
Add Crystal Stones to a wallet | Verify the contract on bookmarked BscScan, or don’t add it | Ad, fan-group CA, “new official”
Pay this academy later | Bookmarked checkout, USDT BEP-20 / the checkout processor | WhatsApp invoice, CST to a mentor
Check a balance | Explorer or wallet read | Dashboard that wants unlimited USDT to view
Meet a new ticker | Practice size, bookmark, finite approve if you ever swap | Last train, VIP, guaranteed
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A cousin sends a contract in WhatsApp: “CST migrated, add this, academy slow.” Sam opens bookmarked BscScan. Middles do not match `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`. Token is forty minutes old.

1. She does not add it. She does not swap “a little to see.” She does not argue for twenty minutes. She sends this lesson’s one-line refusal: verify or nothing.
2. She does not buy the real one as a consolation. This course did not become a buy order because a clone appeared.
3. She checks her play pocket approvals on Sunday like a person who has finished Basic, not like a person hunting listings.
4. Mentor in the app has nothing to say about the clone except what she already knows: never-ask-seed, four doors, bookmarks.

DIAGRAM
See a token name (CST or anything else)
        |
        v
Bookmarked explorer, middle characters
        |
        +--> matches a contract you already meant to verify?  continue as education / your own choice
        +--> new, similar, hurried, VIP, migrated?  no

Academy product
        --> bookmarked LMS, published checkout
        X clone dApps, Mentor DMs, the checkout processor QRs in chat
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Education only. Never a buy, sell, or price target. If you hold Crystal Stones already, you still revoke unknown spenders, still practise small, still refuse clones. Holding is not a halo. If you hold nothing, you still finished the immune system. Rails are the prize of Basic, not a position.
ENDNOTE

Name-collision tokens will keep arriving. Your job is not to catalogue them. Your job is to not hunt. Curiosity that needs a swap is still a swap. Curiosity that needs an unlimited approve is still a gun. The verify-only string is enough. Everything else can wait for Intermediate’s slower tools, or it can wait forever.

## What this lesson is for

So that the project this academy is named after does not get a free pass, and so that every other ticker inherits the same refuse-lines. Verify. Don’t hunt clones. Don’t let a crystal skip a door.

## Say this out loud

- Crystal Stones, if I verify it, is `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00` on BNB Smart Chain — a verify step, not a buy order.
- A similar name is a clone until a bookmark says otherwise. I do not hunt clones.
- Academy Mentor, certificates, and checkout do not need a seed, a permit, or a WhatsApp QR.
- Any other token uses the same four doors. Being on a chain is not a quality stamp.
- I can finish Basic holding nothing. Rails were the job.

# Basic track close: five courses, one job — rails, not a trading career

You have finished the Basic map. The job was not to make you a trader. It was to make you **hard to steal from** and **hard to confuse**. If a friend asks what you studied, that sentence is enough, then the five titles.

By the end of this lesson you should name the five courses in order, name the four doors without looking, and refuse the idea that Basic was a starter pack for guaranteed profit.

## The five courses, as one immune system

1. **Crypto Foundations** — money as ledgers, Bitcoin as history, keys as power of attorney, tokens as rows on a book. Crystal Stones as one project on one network, not the definition of crypto.
2. **Wallets, Keys & Self-Custody** — the key manager, seed, receive and send, practice amounts. Trust Wallet and MetaMask as **examples of wallet apps**, not endorsements.
3. **Exchanges & Your First Buy** — IOUs, KYC, 2FA, P2P receipts that are not settlement, BEP-20 withdraw, test send. Binance as **an example of a centralised exchange**.
4. **Blockchain & BNB Smart Chain** — chain id 56, BNB for gas, BscScan, contracts, the Crystal Stones address as a verify step.
5. **Crypto Safety & Common Scams** — four doors, phishing, people, drains, first hour, checklist. This course. The immune system.

If a friend only has time for one Safety slice, send them never-ask-seed, the four doors, and the panic-day procedure. Then send them into this course properly. A slice is not a personality. A course is a set of drills.

Each earlier course already trained a refuse-line this one reused. Foundations: the chain will not parent you. Wallets: a seed is not a password you reset. Exchanges: a receipt is not settlement, and a withdrawal is the moment self-custody starts. BSC: the contract string in the middle characters beats a logo. Safety: name the door, then pick the fix. If you cannot name which course a mistake belongs to, name the door anyway. Doors are the index.

You are allowed to replay. Quizzes are doors, not decorations. Re-opening Wallets because you never wrote the paper backup is more adult than collecting a Safety certificate over an empty vault.

## What you will still refuse, as a list you can screenshot *without* a seed in the frame

- seeds, private keys, 2FA, remote control, in any chat
- ads as navigation
- send-first doubles and verify-by-sending-USDT
- surprise migrations and secret official contracts
- revoke tools from ads, especially seed-first
- recovery wizards, dust tracers, mixer-detectives
- painted platforms a lover sent
- last trains, VIP recruitment, guaranteed yield
- hardware as a licence to sign blindly
- this academy as a buy order

TABLE
If you only remember four sentences | Why they earn the slot
I am the security team. | Finality has no parent
Match the network to the book. | Wrong book, gone value
Explorer beats screenshots. | The book names the door
Academy never asks for the words. | Costume test
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A stall-owner who finished all five is invited, the same week, to a VIP CST doubling, a fake the checkout processor certificate invoice, and a “job” testing a dApp. She does not need new theory.

1. Send-first is a donation. Invoice she did not start in the app is fake billing. Secret job is a task mill.
2. She runs panic-day in miniature: no, bookmark, name the door. Human, human, human.
3. Sunday she still checks approvals. Play pocket still play-sized.
4. She does not become a group detective. She warns two people with the domain. She goes back to the stall. Rails, not a career in other people’s adrenaline.

DIAGRAM

  Foundations --> Wallets --> Exchanges --> BSC --> Safety
        |
        v
Harder to steal from, harder to confuse
        |
        v
Intermediate later, if you choose it (paid track when live)
  contracts, DeFi, tokenomics, markets as study
  still no guaranteed profit
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you felt behind in any of the five, you are allowed to replay a lesson. Quizzes are doors, not decorations. This academy would rather you re-open Wallets than pretend Safety can parent a seed you never wrote down.
ENDNOTE

Each earlier course already trained a refuse-line this one reused. Foundations: the chain will not parent you. Wallets: a seed is not a password you reset. Exchanges: a receipt is not settlement, and a withdrawal is the moment self-custody starts. BSC: the contract string in the middle characters beats a logo. Safety: name the door, then pick the fix. If you cannot name which course a mistake belongs to, name the door anyway. Doors are the index.

## What this lesson is for

So that the track has a close, not a cliff. You know what you were trained for: rails. You know what you were not trained for: a living as a trader, a recovery agent, or a recruiter. If someone congratulates you by sending a “graduate VIP contract,” that is Module 3 on graduation day. Refuse it with the same paragraph you already have.

## Say this out loud

- Basic’s job was rails: hard to steal from, hard to confuse — not a trading career.
- Five courses: Foundations, Wallets, Exchanges, BNB Smart Chain, Safety.
- Four doors: device, account, chain permission, human. Explorer beats screenshots.
- Academy never asks for the words, the OTP, the screen, or a verifying send.
- I can warn a friend with never-ask-seed, four doors, and panic-day, then send them into the course.

Graduation week is a hunting season. A “graduate VIP contract” is Module 3 with a certificate costume. The refuse-list does not expire because a quiz went green.

Next: what Intermediate will add — contracts, DeFi, tokenomics — and what it will still refuse.

# What Intermediate will add (contracts, DeFi, tokenomics) and what it will still refuse (guaranteed profit)

Basic ends here. Intermediate, when you choose it and when that paid track is live, is more rails — thicker rails — not a personality transplant into a trader who cannot be touched. Checkout, if you ever pay it, is the published USDT BEP-20 the checkout processor flow from the bookmarked site. Not a Mentor DM. Not Crystal Stones token as tuition.

By the end of this lesson you should know what the next track is for, what it will still refuse, and how to live between tracks without hunting clones to “stay sharp.”

## What Intermediate is for (preview, not a syllabus you must buy tonight)

- **Contracts** — reading what a BEP-20 actually permits, what a router does, why allowance exists, how to look at a verified source without pretending you audited it professionally
- **DeFi** — using a DEX as a tool with finite approves, knowing pools can be empty or hostile, knowing “connect” is not a ritual of belonging
- **Tokenomics** — supply, unlocks, who can mint, what a claim is worth as a claim rather than as a guarantee
- **Markets as study** — how pairs and order books work, still without a signal group, still without “the last train”

None of that cancels Safety. Unlimited approve is still a gun. A new contract is still a stranger. A yield number is still not a law of physics.

## What it will still refuse

Guaranteed profit. Risk-free return. Academy-as-broker. Staff as recovery agents. Seed collection. “Verify by sending.” Secret listings in VIP rooms. Hardware as a blind-sign licence. Police reversal as a product feature.

If a person selling Intermediate (or a clone of Intermediate) needs those costumes, they are not this academy. The never-list does not expire when you pay. Paid is a checkout event. It is not a halo.

## How to live after Basic, even if Intermediate waits

Run the Sunday list. Keep practice amounts. Keep two pockets if you have two piles. Keep bookmarks. Keep the operator number on paper. Treat Crystal Stones as a contract to verify, not a hunt: `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`. Hold nothing if you want. Hold play size if you want. This course will not grade your position. It will grade whether you can name a door.

Teach one person the never-ask-seed paragraph without making them your downline. Teaching is not recruitment. Recruitment that needs their deposit is Module 3.

TABLE
Intermediate may add | Intermediate will still refuse | You already have
Reading contracts more slowly | Guaranteed profit, signal VIP | Four doors, panic-day, weekly list
Using DeFi tools as tools | Seed / OTP / remote / verifying send | Bookmarks, finite-approve instinct
Tokenomics as claims to check | Academy-as-broker, recovery DMs | Verify-only CST address
Markets as vocabulary | Last trains, painted desks | Practice amounts
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** Two graduates. One waits six months, runs Sundays, holds nothing, uses an exchange IOU for ordinary payments. One continues to Intermediate when it is live, pays through bookmarked checkout, still rejects a “DeFi boost” APK in the same week as lesson one.

1. Both finished Basic honestly. Neither is behind. Rails do not expire.
2. The second still treats a hex blob as reject. A new module is not a new personality.
3. A third person buys a fake Intermediate from a WhatsApp invoice. That person needed this lesson, not a discount. Sam sends them the never-list and the bookmarked site. She does not send her remaining address.
4. The chain, this whole time, will still settle a theft as calmly as a gift. That is why Safety sat last in Basic, not first as a scare and not never.

DIAGRAM
After Basic
   |
   +--> live the checklist, practice size, bookmarks
   +--> optional Intermediate (published checkout only)
   |
   still refuse
     guaranteed profit
     seeds in chat
     recovery theatre
     clone hunts
     last trains
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
If you never take Intermediate, you did not fail Crystal Stones Academy Basic. You finished the immune system. That was the assignment. Anyone who says Basic was incomplete unless you buy the next thing is selling. We will invite you. We will not kidnap you with a timer.
ENDNOTE

Between tracks, curiosity will itch. Feed it with the Sunday list and the BSC course’s explorer drills, not with a VIP room. If a friend is already in Intermediate, they still do not get your seed to “show you a pool.” Teaching is questions about concepts. It is not a screen share of a funded wallet. The never-list does not have a graduate exception.

## What this lesson is for

So that the door out of Basic is a door, not a funnel. You know the next map exists. You know it will not parent you either. You know what you will still refuse on the days nobody is grading a quiz.

## Say this out loud

- Intermediate, if I choose it, adds contracts, DeFi, and tokenomics as study — not guaranteed profit.
- Paid checkout is published USDT BEP-20 / the checkout processor from a bookmark, never a Mentor DM.
- The never-list does not expire when I pay, and it does not expire if I wait.
- I can live on the Sunday checklist holding nothing. Rails were the job of Basic.
- The chain will still settle a theft as calmly as a gift. I remain the security team.

Between tracks, feed curiosity with explorer drills and the Sunday list, not a VIP room. A graduate still does not share a seed so a friend can “show a pool.”

Take the quiz. Use the checklist on Sunday. If you teach one person, teach them this: Crystal Stones Academy will never ask for a seed phrase, and will never DM you a recovery agent.
